title: Gemini API function declarations (`parameters`, OpenAPI 3.0 subset)
applies_to: tools[].functionDeclarations[].parameters in generateContent requests; the shape most Gemini clients convert MCP inputSchema into

rules.title: `type` must be a single value, not a list
rules.rationale: Schema.type is a single Type enum. A list such as ["string","null"] fails with 'Proto field is not repeating, cannot start list'. Nullability is the boolean `nullable` field.

rules.title: anyOf/oneOf with a null branch (Optional[T])
rules.rationale: The documented way to express an optional value is `nullable: true`. The docs list `anyOf` and a NULL type, so the API itself may accept anyOf[T, null]; the reported 400s come from common client converters that turn it into a list-valued `type`. Marked unverified for that reason; the rewrite is lossless.

rules.title: `const` is not a Schema field
rules.rationale: The Schema object has no `const` field; use a one-value `enum`.

rules.title: `$ref` / `$defs` / `definitions` are not Schema fields
rules.rationale: The Schema object has no reference fields; local references must be inlined before sending.

rules.title: `oneOf` is not a Schema field
rules.rationale: Only `anyOf` is available. Rewriting oneOf to anyOf loosens validation (an instance matching several branches becomes valid).

rules.title: `allOf` is not a Schema field
rules.rationale: Only `anyOf` is available. allOf branches are merged into the parent when they do not conflict; otherwise allOf is dropped (loosens validation).

rules.title: Keyword is not part of the Gemini Schema subset
rules.rationale: Gemini's Schema object accepts only: type, format, title, description, nullable, enum, maxItems, minItems, properties, required, minProperties, maxProperties, minLength, maxLength, pattern, example, anyOf, propertyOrdering, default, items, minimum, maximum. Unknown fields are rejected by the proto parser ('Unknown name ...').

rules.title: `enum` values must be strings
rules.rationale: Schema.enum is documented as string[]; numeric or boolean enums cannot be represented.

rules.title: Every schema needs a `type`
rules.rationale: Schema.type is documented as Required. mcpdialect infers it from other keywords (properties -> object, items -> array, string enum -> string) when it can.

rules.title: Function name characters and length
rules.rationale: FunctionDeclaration.name must be a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores, colons, dots, and dashes, with a maximum length of 128.
